C0561.title: Man Sentenced to 3.5 Years for Defrauding Online Merchants by Posing as Consumer
C0561.summary: A criminal exploited an e-commerce platform vulnerability by refusing delivery after goods were shipped, then impersonating the seller to resend the merchandise. By rejecting high-value items such as laptops, he illegally possessed the merchants' goods, causing supply chain losses. The offender was ultimately sentenced to three years and six months in prison for fraud.

references.title: Posing as Consumer to Defraud Online Merchants: Man Sentenced to 3 Years and 6 Months
